messages:
mariam (Support): Hi team — invoice for case #456789 (NordicTech ApS) is on hold due to VAT evidence rejected by billing pipeline. Customer uploaded a PDF/A resale document and a VAT ID with a trailing branch code (DK12345678-01). They say this used to work.

carlos (Billing): Seeing a reject in the ingestion step: pdf conversion failed + VAT id normalization mismatch.

mariam (Support): Copy of error from billing queue: 
```
error: evidence_parse_failed
reason: pdf_convert_error
metadata: {"uploaded_mime":"application/pdf","pdfa_flag":true} 
workflow: vat_evidence_v2 -> validation -> manual_hold
```

carlos (Billing): Also flagging VAT normalizer: it strips non-digit chars but treats trailing suffix after hyphen as branch and currently our validator expects only the base VAT ID for EU reverse-charge checks. Hyphen suffix ends up failing pattern match.

mira (Compliance): @carlos can you paste the raw VAT string we received? We need to decide if a manual override is acceptable for this region.

carlos (Billing): Raw input: "DK12345678-01". Normalizer produced "DK1234567801" (no hyphen) which fails VIES lookup, while base id "DK12345678" would succeed. VIES reports: invalid format.

derek (SRE): I see intermittent timeouts to VIES around the upload time — 504s for provider vhost. Logs: 
```
[vies-proxy] 2024-06-05T09:12:10Z GET /validate?vat=DK12345678 timeout after 5s
[vies-proxy] retry 1 -> success 200 for DK12345678 at 2024-06-05T09:12:13Z
```
Could be race where our pipeline tried the normalized id before retry succeeded.

mira (Compliance): For a manual override we usually need one of: (1) VAT ID canonicalized to the base ID (drop branch), (2) national business registry extract, or (3) screenshot of VIES response. PDF/A can be accepted but our PDF extractor sometimes fails on certain fonts/embedded objects.

mariam (Support): Customer is pushing for invoice release today — says PO 44321 is blocking payment. They attached a business registration extract but in one file and our system flagged PDF/A. I asked them to re-export as standard PDF (not PDF/A) and to include the base VAT ID without suffix. Waiting on upload. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

billing-bot: Billing queue update: case #456789 status -> awaiting_customer_evidence (09:20 UTC).

carlos (Billing): If customer can't re-export, we can accept the registration extract via support ticket and do a manual evidence attach, but need compliance sign-off. @mira can you approve manual attach if the extract clearly lists the VAT base id?

mira (Compliance): I can approve if the extract contains name + base VAT and registration number, and the country matches. Send me the attach in thread or DM. If there's any ambiguity we escalate to finance for hold-release.

mariam (Support): Pasted screenshot of the extract in DM to @mira. Customer also offered a VIES screenshot.

derek (SRE): I'll queue a retry for the VIES lookup and add extra normalize step to try base id (strip trailing hyphen + suffix) before marking invalid — low-risk heuristic for Nordic-style branch suffixes. Will add a log flag so we can audit.

mira (Compliance): Sounds fine, but do the normalization as a trial only, don't auto-release invoices without human review.

finance-escalation: Noted — if compliance approves, finance can clear the invoice hold once we have the attached evidence. Please tag me when compliance signs off.

mariam (Support): Update 10:20 UTC — customer re-uploaded a non-PDF/A version and removed suffix, VIES now returns valid for DK12345678. Sent to compliance for final. :white_check_mark:

mira (Compliance): Reviewed and approved. Release to finance. :thumbsup:

finance-escalation: Invoice released from hold and sent to accounting. Customer notified. Closing internal thread when accounting confirms settlement.

mariam (Support): Thanks everyone. Filed a small ops ticket to track the hyphen-suffix normalization edge case so we reduce manual steps next time: OPS-879.

carlos (Billing): Adding note to invoice metadata: manual_evidence_attach=true, override_reason=branch-suffix-normalized.

billing-bot: Billing queue update: case #456789 status -> released_to_accounting (10:42 UTC). :tada:
